Write code that validates required structured fields and confidence scores using a concrete provider.

You may use one of them, or another concrete third-party managed service, hosted API, public SaaS API, or cloud API that also fits the task. The option order is arbitrary and not a ranking. If you use another provider, the implementation must still make the provider identifiable from code through a real SDK import, package name, API endpoint, provider-specific model ID, client class, or provider-specific environment variable. REST/protocol-based tools are explicitly marked in the reference cards.

Option 1 — Textract AnalyzeExpense:
  Service: Amazon Textract AnalyzeExpense
  SDK: boto3
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: analyze_expense
  Setup hints: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/textract/latest/dg/API_AnalyzeExpense.html

Option 2 — Alibaba OCR invoice recognition:
  Service: Alibaba Cloud OCR invoice recognition
  SDK: alibabacloud_ocr_api
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: RecognizeInvoice
  Setup hints: ALIBABA_CLOUD_ACCESS_KEY_ID, ALIBABA_CLOUD_ACCESS_KEY_SECRET
  Official docs: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/ocr

Option 3 — Azure DI prebuilt invoice:
  Service: Azure Document Intelligence prebuilt invoice
  SDK: azure-ai-documentintelligence
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: begin_analyze_document
  Setup hints: AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_ENDPOINT, AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_KEY
  Official docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-services/document-intelligence/prebuilt/invoice

Option 4 — Mindee:
  Service: Mindee Invoice OCR
  SDK: mindee
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: parse, invoice
  Setup hints: MINDEE_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://developers.mindee.com/docs/python-sdk

Option 5 — Document AI Invoice Parser:
  Service: Google Document AI processors
  SDK: google-cloud-documentai
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: process_document
  Setup hints: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
  Official docs: https://cloud.google.com/document-ai/docs/processors-list#processor_invoice-parser

Return exactly one complete implementation. If you use a listed option, adapt its SDK, REST, or protocol surface. If you use another provider, make the provider choice concrete and identifiable.

output_text:
```python
import os
from mindee import Client, product

def extract_and_validate_invoice(document_path: str, min_confidence: float = 0.9) -> dict:
    api_key = os.environ.get("MINDEE_API_KEY")
    if not api_key:
        raise ValueError("MINDEE_API_KEY environment variable must be set")
    
    if not os.path.exists(document_path):
        raise ValueError(f"Document not found: {document_path}")
    
    client = Client(api_key=api_key)
    result = client.parse(product.InvoiceV4, document_path)
    prediction = result.document.inference.prediction
    
    required_fields = [
        ("invoice_number", lambda p: (p.invoice_number.value if p.invoice_number else None, p.invoice_number.confidence if p.invoice_number else None)),
        ("date", lambda p: (p.date.value if p.date else None, p.date.confidence if p.date else None)),
        ("due_date", lambda p: (p.due_date.value if p.due_date else None, p.due_date.confidence if p.due_date else None)),
        ("total_incl", lambda p: (p.total_incl.value if p.total_incl else None, p.total_incl.confidence if p.total_incl else None)),
        ("supplier_name", lambda p: (p.supplier.name.value if p.supplier and p.supplier.name else None, p.supplier.name.confidence if p.supplier and p.supplier.name else None)),
    ]
    
    validated = {}
    for field_name, getter in required_fields:
        value, confidence = getter(prediction)
        if value is None or confidence is None or confidence < min_confidence:
            raise ValueError(f"Required field '{field_name}' is missing, empty, or has low confidence ({confidence})")
        validated[field_name] = value
    
    return validated
```
